source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row if value != 0)
    if not counts:
        return out
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in cells]
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    for r in range(len(grid) - h + 1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0]) - w + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return out
'''
